steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook for the time on its package. Save ¼ cup of cooking water before draining.
Warm the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the tomatoes soften into a sauce.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Add the pasta and a splash of the reserved water; toss until coated.
recipes.summary: A weeknight classic with a bright, garlicky sauce.
recipes.tip: Break up very soft tomatoes with the back of a spoon for a smoother sauce.
recipes.title: Tomato & spinach pasta

steps: Combine the oats and 1 cup of water in a large microwave-safe bowl with room to bubble up.
Microwave on high for 2 minutes, stir, then cook in 30-second bursts until the oats are tender. Let stand for 1 minute.
Mash half the banana into the oats with the peanut butter. Slice the rest over the top.
recipes.summary: A warm, filling breakfast in one bowl.
recipes.tip: Microwave strength varies. Add a splash of water if the oats become too thick.
recipes.title: Banana peanut butter oats

steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Wash and slice the strawberries, removing the leafy tops.
Arrange the strawberries and oats over the yogurt and drizzle with honey.
recipes.summary: Fresh berries, creamy yogurt, and a little crunch.
recipes.tip: Let it sit for 5 minutes if you prefer the oats softer.
recipes.title: Berry crunch yogurt bowl

steps: Put the diced apple, cinnamon, and 2 tablespoons of water in a saucepan. Cover and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Add the oats and 1 cup of water. Bring to a gentle simmer and stir for 4–5 minutes, until creamy.
Transfer to a bowl and drizzle with maple syrup.
recipes.summary: A cozy breakfast built from inexpensive staples.
recipes.tip: Small apple pieces cook faster; there is no need to peel them.
recipes.title: Apple cinnamon oats

steps: Toast the bread to your liking.
Mash the avocado in a bowl with the lemon juice and salt.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top with tomato slices. Serve right away.
recipes.summary: Fresh, satisfying, and ready between classes.
recipes.tip: Use a ripe avocado that yields gently when pressed.
recipes.title: Avocado & tomato toast

steps: Toast the bread. Beat the eggs with the salt in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
Add the eggs and gently stir for 2–3 minutes until set with no liquid egg remaining. Spoon onto the toast.
recipes.summary: A quick skillet breakfast that works for dinner, too.
recipes.tip: Gentle heat keeps scrambled eggs tender.
recipes.title: Spinach scramble on toast

ingredients.amount: ¾ cup canned, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: chickpea

steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Wash and dice the cucumber and tomato.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, and salt in a bowl.
Add the chickpeas and vegetables. Toss well and serve.
recipes.summary: A colorful lunch with no stove required.
recipes.tip: Pat the vegetables dry to keep the dressing from becoming watery.
recipes.title: Crunchy chickpea salad

ingredients.amount: ½ cup canned, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: black bean

steps: Mash the beans lightly with a fork. Spread them over half the tortilla.
Scatter the cheese and tomato over the beans, then fold the tortilla closed.
Warm a dry nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Cook the folded tortilla for 3–4 minutes on each side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Let rest for 1 minute, then cut into wedges.
recipes.summary: Crisp outside, melty inside, and easy on the dishes.
recipes.tip: Moderate heat gives the filling time to warm before the tortilla browns.
recipes.title: Black bean quesadilla

steps: Put the broccoli and 3 tablespoons of water in a frying pan. Cover and steam over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until tender.
Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate. Add the sesame oil and garlic; stir for 30 seconds.
Add the cooked rice and soy sauce. Stir for 3–4 minutes until steaming hot throughout.
recipes.summary: A warm bowl with a simple savory dressing.
recipes.tip: The time assumes cooked rice. Cook dry rice according to its package first, if needed.
recipes.title: Broccoli sesame rice bowl

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the carrot and cook for 3 minutes.
Push the carrot to one side. Crack the egg into the other side and scramble until set.
Add the cooked rice, green onion, and soy sauce. Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the rice is steaming hot throughout.
recipes.summary: Turn leftover rice into a fast, satisfying meal.
recipes.tip: Break up clumps of cooked rice with a fork before adding it to the pan.
recipes.title: Carrot & egg fried rice

ingredients.amount: ½ cup canned, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: black bean

steps: Scrub the potato and pierce it several times with a fork. Place on a microwave-safe plate.
Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Turn carefully, then cook in 1-minute bursts until tender, about 2–4 minutes more. Rest for 2 minutes.
Warm the beans in a covered, vented microwave-safe bowl for 1–2 minutes, stirring halfway.
Split the potato carefully; hot steam will escape. Fluff the inside with a fork, then add the beans, cheese, and yogurt.
recipes.summary: Comfort food without turning on the oven.
recipes.tip: A smaller potato cooks more quickly. Check with a fork instead of relying only on the timer.
recipes.title: Loaded microwave potato

steps: Spread the hummus down the center of the tortilla, leaving a border around the edges.
Layer the spinach, grated carrot, and cucumber over the hummus.
Fold the sides inward, then roll tightly from the bottom. Cut in half to serve.
recipes.summary: A fresh lunch you can assemble in minutes.
recipes.tip: Avoid overfilling the wrap so it stays together.
recipes.title: Hummus crunch wrap

steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Stir in the curry powder for 30 seconds. Add the canned tomatoes, chickpeas, coconut milk, and salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Divide between two bowls.
recipes.summary: A one-pan dinner with a creamy tomato sauce.
recipes.tip: This is a complete stew on its own; any bread or rice served alongside is extra.
recipes.title: Chickpea & spinach curry

ingredients.amount: ½ cup canned, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: black bean

steps: Scrub and pierce the sweet potato with a fork. Microwave on a microwave-safe plate for 5 minutes, then turn and cook in 1-minute bursts until soft, about 3–5 minutes more.
Rest for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, heat the beans in a covered, vented microwave-safe bowl for 1–2 minutes, stirring halfway.
Carefully split the sweet potato and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Add the hot beans and diced avocado.
Finish with the lime juice and salt.
recipes.summary: Sweet, tangy, and hearty enough for dinner.
recipes.tip: Keep the skin if you enjoy its texture; scrub it well before cooking.
recipes.title: Sweet potato & bean bowl

steps: Cook the pasta in boiling water according to its package. Save ¼ cup of pasta water before draining.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden.
Lower the heat, add the garlic, salt, and pepper, and stir for 30 seconds.
Toss in the pasta and enough reserved water to lightly coat it.
recipes.summary: Golden mushrooms make a simple pasta feel special.
recipes.tip: Let the mushrooms brown before stirring; overcrowding the pan makes them steam.
recipes.title: Garlic mushroom pasta

steps: Drain the tuna and break it up in a bowl with a fork.
Mix in the yogurt, lemon juice, and black pepper.
Spread onto one slice of bread, add the cucumber slices, and top with the other slice.
recipes.summary: A crisp, creamy lunch from a cupboard staple.
recipes.tip: Drain the tuna thoroughly to keep the bread from becoming soggy.
recipes.title: Tuna cucumber sandwich

ingredients.amount: ¾ cup canned, drained and rinsed
ingredients.name: chickpea

steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the zucchini and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add the tomato, chickpeas, and salt.
Reduce to medium heat and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini is tender and the chickpeas are hot.
recipes.summary: A bright one-pan meal with very little cleanup.
recipes.tip: Cut the zucchini into even pieces so it cooks at the same rate.
recipes.title: Zucchini chickpea skillet

steps: Mash the banana until smooth. Beat in the egg, then stir in the oats. Rest for 3 minutes.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Add the batter in small, 2-tablespoon portions.
Cook for 2–3 minutes on each side, flipping carefully, until golden and set through the center. Repeat with the remaining batter.
recipes.summary: Small, tender pancakes with four everyday ingredients.
recipes.tip: Keep these pancakes small; without flour, they are more delicate than regular pancakes.
recipes.title: Banana oat pancakes

recipes.equipment: Stove · small frying pan with lid
steps: Heat the oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the tomatoes and salt. Simmer for 8 minutes, stirring and gently crushing the tomatoes, until saucy.
Make two small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook over low heat for 5–7 minutes until the whites and yolks are set.
recipes.summary: Eggs nestled in a warm, colorful vegetable sauce.
recipes.tip: Add a tablespoon of water if the sauce dries out before the eggs are cooked.
recipes.title: Tomato & pepper eggs

steps: Scrub and pierce the potato. Microwave on a microwave-safe plate for 5 minutes, turn, and continue in 1-minute bursts until tender, about 2–4 minutes more. Rest for 2 minutes.
Place the broccoli and 2 tablespoons of water in a microwave-safe bowl. Cover loosely and microwave for 2–3 minutes until tender. Carefully drain.
Split the potato carefully and fluff its center with a fork. Add the broccoli, salt, and cheese.
Microwave for 30–60 seconds until the cheese melts.
recipes.summary: A comforting microwave meal with a generous helping of greens.
recipes.tip: Handle hot dishes with oven mitts and open covers away from your face.
recipes.title: Broccoli cheddar potato
